signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: We are manufacturer producing the Xenon Aging Testing Chamber
Environmental Test Chambers and Temperature and Humidity Test Chamber/ High and Low Temperature Test Chambers etc.

The Xenon Aging Testing Chamber is widely applied to simulate full sunlight spectrum xenon arc lamps to reproduce the existence of different environments destructive waves, xenon climatic environment test chamber can provide the appropriate environment for the simulation of scientific research, product development and quality control, and accelerated testing.

Environmental Test Chambers are widely used to test the performance of materials in various environments and to test various materials for heat resistance, cold resistance, dry resistance and moisture resistance.
With original France Taikang imported full-tight compressor and good inner box & out box material.
If any demand, please contact us for further information.

Thank you!
